items: Some specialist postgraduate courses are shorter and require appropriate prior qualifications.

Aerodynamics and Computational Fluid Dynamics

Flight Mechanics and Control Systems

Guidance, Navigation and Control

These \\master's courses in Aerospace Engineering in France\\ give students the chance to gain specialized knowledge for a career in the aviation, aircraft manufacturing and space technology industries.

sections.title: Eligibility to Study Aerospace Engineering PG in France
sections.lead: The eligibility criteria for students applying for \\Aerospace Engineering PG in France\\ is generally as follows:

items: Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or any other science or engineering field related to the position.
Solid background in mathematics, physics, mechanics, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics
Good academic results during undergraduate studies.
English language proficiency for English-taught programs, where applicable.
French language proficiency if required for French taught programs.
Other academic prerequisites required by the institution.
Depending on the program, graduates in electrical engineering, electronics, computer science, mechatronics or applied physics may also be considered.

sections.title: Admission Requirement in Aerospace Engineering
sections.lead: French universities and engineering schools evaluate candidates on academic results, preparation in the subjects and aptitude for the specialization chosen.

items: Typical \\Aerospace Engineering admission requirements in France\\ are:
Relevant bachelor degree or accepted equivalent qualification.
Official academic transcripts
A CV or résumé with details of education, technical skills, projects and internships.
Statement of purpose or motivation letter.
Letters of recommendation (if required).
Test results, if applicable, in English or French.
Interview or further assessment as required.

Some specialized programs require a four-year bachelor's degree or equivalent preparation, while others may accept a relevant three-year bachelor's degree. Applicants should check the entry level requirements of the course they have chosen.

sections.title: Recognition and Accreditation of Aerospace Engineering Degrees
sections.lead: Students should check what qualification is actually awarded by the institution before accepting an offer.

items: A \\diplôme national de master\\, the French national master's degree, is recognized within the French higher education system and the European higher education framework. This usually corresponds to five years of higher education, in addition to what came before at the bachelor's level.

Another qualification is the engineering diploma ( \ diplôme d'ingénieur \ ) . Applicants for engineering-school programs should verify that the institution is authorized and, where relevant, recognized by the Commission des titres d'ingénieur (CTI).
Check before you apply:
Title of the degree and the awarding institution.
whether the program leads to a national master's degree, an engineering diploma or a specialization.
The institution's accreditation or recognition status.
The length and academic credit.
Recognition requirements for employment or further study in your country of choice.
Students from India who want to go back after graduation should check qualification requirements with potential employers, universities or the appropriate authorities.

sections.title: Aerospace Engineering PG Salary & Job Opportunities in France
sections.lead: A \\Master's in Aerospace Engineering in France\\ can help you find career opportunities in aircraft design, space systems, propulsion, simulation, aerospace structures, and engineering research.

items: Employment results depend on technical skills, internships, professional experience, language skills, security or export-control restrictions where applicable and the hiring market.
\\Potential jobs after doing a PG in Aerospace Engineering in France are\\:
Aerospace Design Engineer
Aerodynamics Engineer
Computational Fluid Dynamics Engineer
Aerospace Structures Engineer
Propulsion Engineer
Flight Dynamics Engineer
Space Systems Engineer
Avionics or Control Systems Engineer
Aircraft Performance Engineer
Aerospace Testing and Validation Engineer
Research and Development Engineer
Simulation Engineer

Possible employers are aircraft manufacturing, space systems, aviation, defense, engineering consultancies, advanced materials and research organizations. Certain positions may require citizenship, security clearance, or export control qualifications, especially those related to defense contracts.
Expected Salary in France after PG in Aerospace Engineering
There is not a one salary for all aerospace engineering graduates. Compensation varies by employer, role, location, experience, technical specialization and contract type.

Students are to compare current job advertisements and salary surveys for the field they have chosen. When you are evaluating a job offer, take into account gross salary, taxes and social contributions, housing costs and other living expenses.

faqs.q: How long is a postgraduate aerospace engineering course in France?
faqs.a: A national master's degree usually lasts two years, consisting of M1 and M2, with 120 ECTS credits. Postgraduate qualifications for specialists vary in length and entry requirements.

faqs.q: Can Indian students do Aerospace Engineering PG in France?
faqs.a: Yeah. Indian students can apply for \\Aerospace Engineering PG in France\\ if they meet the academic, language, and documentation requirements. Being accepted to a university and being issued a student visa are two separate things.

faqs.q: Do I have to take IELTS for aerospace engineering masters in France?
faqs.a: Not every time. English taught programs may require IELTS, TOEFL or an equivalent accepted test or approved proof of previous education in English. Some of the programs are taught in French and may require proficiency in French.

faqs.q: Aerospace Engineering PG Tuition Fee in France?
faqs.a: For 2026-2027 the indicative annual fee for a national master's degree at covered public institutions is €255 for EU/EEA/Swiss students and €3,950 for non-EU students liable to differential fees. Specialist aerospace programs and engineering schools may have different tuition arrangements .

faqs.q: 5: What are the jobs after PG in Aerospace Engineering in France?
faqs.a: Graduates may be employed in aircraft design, aerodynamics, propulsion, aerospace structures, space systems, flight dynamics, avionics and research and development. Opportunities will depend on technical skills, experience, language ability and employer needs.
